title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: A goal the team picks
hook: What would your team say they want to get better at?
statement: Kids work harder for goals they helped choose.
q1: Do you let the team pick a goal for the week —
q2: or set goals yourself based on what you see?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But effort grows
t2: when kids help decide what matters.
cta: Coaches — who sets your team goals?
ctaLines: Team vote. Captains pick. Coach decides.
ctaPrompt: Share your goal habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What would your team say they want to get better at?
You always set the goals. Kids follow along.
Kids work harder for goals they helped choose.
The team picks or the coach picks. Both can work.
Who sets your team goals? Share your habit in the comments.
